_about: Every pose a companion can have (AGENTS.md, Companion art), each listed once. The core set a companion needs to go live is `core` (the core moods, in this order), `pictures` (the moment and share-card pictures the apps show) and `icons` (the launcher icon moods; `icon` is the default one). `extensions` are tiers and variants of a core item. Every item but a core mood names the item a companion without its master shows instead, which is a core mood or an item whose chain reaches one. hill, 2026-11-21: Ankilope, Bluma and Anki-tan stay live while their missing core items are drawn (AnkiQuest/AnkiQuest-Server#57, #116) and show these fallbacks meanwhile; a new companion goes live only with every core item drawn. A PR adding an item here draws it for every live companion; CI checks that with `xtask art-coverage --since`. `xtask art-coverage` reports which companion has which item.
